answer.book: Tomus Secundus of Johannes Hoornbeeck's Socinianismi confutati (Amsterdam, Waesberge, 1672 printing, title dated 1650): a Latin theological treatise in three books refuting Socinian doctrine, each book divided into caputs and controversies, with a dedication, prolegomena, syllabus of questions and two indexes at the back.
